events.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 30 at 5:43PM PDT until October 31 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Seattle WA
events.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 34 will result in frost formation.
Temperatures may vary due to clearing or fog development in
localized areas.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Washington.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 9 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The growing season officially ends on October
31, after which no further frost or freeze headlines will be
issued.
events.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
